design.coverage: all eleven questions, identity/gzip and declared workload strata
design.loadDesign: closed and open ladders through calibrated capacity and overload regions
design.repeats: at least four balanced pairs in independent experiments; freeze the full statistical family
design.primary: qualified P50/P95/P99, goodput, error/drop rate and supported resource diagnostics
design.samplePolicy: P99 minimum 1000 correct observations in each physical run; independent pair/experiment and family-wide rules remain explicit
design.calibration: accepted repeatability, known-regression sensitivity, driver headroom, steady state and observer cost; no automatic qualification

limitations: Hours is a design scale, with no validated upper ETA. Full is not executable in this release.
Strata, budgets and global family allocation require a future versioned implementation; no hidden splitting or sample pooling.
Fine resource and cross-clock attribution require their own evidence and remain separate from HTTP correctness.
